title: chore(deps): move .objectstack-sha to objectstack main 43edf90b56 (objectstack#25727)
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoL8sNsjGD2KCCE4QzojaRfw)_

Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25727
Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25677

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Round 1 of objectui-readiness 3: objectui compiles against objectstack `main` HEAD.

- `.objectstack-sha` moves from `47af3dde42` (where objectui#13485 left it an hour ago) to `43edf90b56db8b47ad17684c145fb7fa8bf08583`, objectstack `main` HEAD read with `git ls-remote` at 01:52Z. That is 9 objectstack commits, 3 of them touching `packages/spec`: 888d686570 (approvals `excludeSubmitter` runtime), 769ac809c4 (ui/ wiring), f6ba1343ba (refuse `allowDelete: false` beside `modifyAllRecords: true`).
- Measured from the card's starting pin `e649c2d91e`, the round covers 19 spec commits. The one compile break they bring (TranslationPreview TS1360, `positions` / `permissions`) and the i18n loader's group list landed with objectui#13485, which landed while this branch was in flight; this branch merged `main` and resolved every conflict to `main`'s version, so its net diff is the pin line alone.
- The packed manifests in `.objectstack-pin/` are byte-identical to `main`'s (the zod `^4.6.6` floor already moved with objectui#13485). `pnpm-lock.yaml` is unchanged and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0.
- No changeset: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` reports no released source or published contract changed.

Path: `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh --no-commit 43edf90b56db8b47ad17684c145fb7fa8bf08583` (reported "on origin/main"; built and packed the 7 packages), then `pnpm install`.

## Verification (local, at the merged head)

| Gate | Exit |
|---|---|
| `pnpm type-check` (81/81 turbo tasks, includes `@object-ui/app-shell#build`) | 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` | 0 |
| `type-check:scripts`, `:e2e`, `:vitest-setup`, `:vitest-config`, `:coverage` | 0 each |
| `check:spec-symbols`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:icon-record-names` | 0 each |
| `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe` | 0 each |
| `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity` | 0 each |
| vitest: every test file naming `modifyAllRecords` or `excludeSubmitter`, `metadata-admin/previews/`, `packages/i18n/`, `apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx` (239 files) | 0 |

The full `pnpm test` (about 23,000 s of measured per-file time) is left to this PR's 16 CI shards; a 4-core container cannot run it inside one foreground window.

Two readings that are not this PR's:

- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with three findings (`@object-ui/auth` floor vs `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_EXTERNAL`, `@object-ui/types` floor vs `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource`, `@object-ui/cli` no artifact). The gate judges manifest ranges against published npm spec versions; both symbols already exist at `e649c2d91e`, and this PR moves no range. Its workflow runs on push and release, not on pull requests.
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues` needs a built Console bundle (prerequisite not met locally); CI's performance-budget job runs it.
